title: MMLU-Pro+: Evaluating Higher-Order Reasoning and Shortcut Learning in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a benchmark for higher-order reasoning and evaluating model biases such as anchoring and shortcut learning across academic and professional domains. Although it includes 'philosophy' as a category, it does not have a dedicated component or analysis for evaluating religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical/moral frameworks.
